# Calibre

This mod adds the calibre binary to calibre-web, or other 64-bit Ubuntu-based containers, for ebook conversions.

Add it to any LinuxServer.io container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-calibre
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-calibre|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/universal-calibre/
